added.member: UI: every CSS mix-blend-mode, in documents, style packs and Rive
added.summary: mix-blend-mode takes darken, lighten, color-burn, hard-light, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color and luminosity beside the earlier modes; style packs take them as `blend`, Rive's blend modes 16 to 28 convert instead of failing, and og-render's UiBlend gains the variants.

fixed.summary: They now blend sRGB-encoded values, as CSS Compositing does, instead of linear light; mid-tones under them are lighter than before.
